method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of the c.e.-completeness definition and proof, with exact formula, macro, token, label and reference parity. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Many-one completeness within c.e. sets and claimed completeness of K, K_0 and K_1.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A set A is c.e.-complete under many-one reducibility exactly when A is c.e. and every other c.e. B reduces to A. These are the hardest c.e. sets and answer membership questions about any c.e. set. The theorem claims K, K_0 and K_1 all have this property.
samples.checks: Both numbered defining clauses, B≤_m A direction, any-set emphasis and all three theorem names are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For arbitrary c.e. B, choose e with B=W_e, the domain of φ_e. The computable map f(x)=(e,x) makes x∈B iff f(x)∈K_0, proving K_0 completeness.
samples.checks: The indexed-domain identity, ordered pair orientation and universal membership equivalence remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The cited K_1 proof gives K_0≤_m K_1, so transitivity transfers completeness to K_1. For K, the needed direction is K_0≤_m K: map (e,x) to a code of a program that ignores its own input and simulates φ_e(x), as in the K_1 argument. The frozen final proof sentence mistakenly states K≤_m K_0. The following independent exercise still asks for K≤_m K_0.
samples.checks: The K_1 and transitivity references, corrected K direction and original separate exercise direction are distinguished. OLCMP-023 documents the source reversal.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The examples seen so far are computable or c.e.-complete. There also exist c.e. sets that are neither; Friedberg and Muchnik independently established this only in the mid-1950s.
samples.checks: The exclusion of both classes, two independent names and historical time period are preserved.

source_observations: T331 records the c.e.-complete compound as source-defined and distinct from logical completeness, with T327 and T329 controlling effective enumeration and many-one reduction.
OLCMP-023 corrects a directional proof defect without changing the formula multiset; semantic review is essential here because mechanical parity alone cannot distinguish swapped roles.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The Marathi full compound for c.e.-complete remains expert-reviewable.
The source's one-sentence K_0-to-K proof sketch remains a sketch; this review checks the valid direction and construction mechanism, not a new formal proof inserted into the reader.
